items.title: Druski hosts SNL and turns himself into Elizabeth Holmes
items.summary: Druski, the first content creator to host SNL, joked in his monologue that the show's rules included "no whiteface" and that he couldn't promise that. Then, in "Dru Can See Everything," a parody of Nathan Fielder's Holmes documentary, he emerged in prosthetics, a blonde wig and blue contacts as Elizabeth Holmes for a "Holmes-off" with Jane Wickline: "I'm always being real." "I could do this all day, bitch. You don't scare me." The studio audience screamed, Pop Base's still of Druski as Holmes drew 102K likes, Dave Chappelle and Chris Rock surprised him at the goodnights, and the whiteface was argued about all weekend as his Wikipedia page hit 122K views.
